summary: Obfuscated mass-mailer / phishing operator toolkit; no install-time or import-time attack on the installer
details: monogrok is a heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io RC4 + string-array) Node.js CLI that ships operator tooling for bulk-email abuse: AWS SES and SendGrid credential probing and sending modules (func/smx/aws.js, func/smx/sendgrid.js, func/smx/sgapi.js), SMTP dispatchers (func/snd/mlr/*), IMAP/POP3/EWS mailbox access modules that consume operator-supplied cookies and credentials (func/box/imap.js, func/box/pop3.js, func/box/ewsv.js, func/box/ckie.js), Shodan-driven open-SMTP-relay hunting (func/sho/*), LinkedIn/Crunchbase-style contact extractors (func/emx/lnkdn.js and siblings), and a URL redirector builder (func/rdt/*). Every file is obfuscated with the obfuscator.io hexadecimal-identifier pattern. package.json declares no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare lifecycle scripts; the single bin entry (`monogrok` -> `oibWljdTg.js`) is invoked only when an operator explicitly runs the CLI. The abusive behavior is directed at third-party mailbox owners, mail providers, and the recipients of the spam/phishing traffic; installing or importing this package does not read installer secrets, does not fetch or execute remote code, does not open a backdoor, and does not exfiltrate data from the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
